special.value: You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different debilitation each time.

description.value:
Add one of the following to the debilitations from which you can choose when you Envenom. These debilitations reduce the damage of all stages as noted.

- Bungling (level 13) Reduce damage by 1 die

- Stage 1: no effect
- Stage 2: clumsy 1
- Stage 3: clumsy 2

- Devitalizing (level 13) Reduce damage by 3 dice

- Stage 1: no effect
- Stage 2: drained 1
- Stage 3: drained 2

- Nauseating (level 13) Reduce damage by 2 dice

- Stage 1: no effect
- Stage 2: sickened 1
- Stage 3: sickened 2

- Weakening (level 13) Reduce damage by 1 die

- Stage 1: enfeebled 1
- Stage 2: enfeebled 1
- Stage 3: enfeebled 2
